catalogue_requests.reason: no catalogue class moves a microscope stage axis to an absolute position in micrometres: cap.motion.joint_position.v1 is in radians and binds robot.arm/motion.axis, and cap.optics.align.v1 is an alignment search that needs a permit and an alignment quality this stage cannot report, so the package uses an extension id with an inline schema
catalogue_requests.summary: Move one stage axis (x, y or z) to an absolute position in micrometres and report the position it then reads.

catalogue_requests.reason: no catalogue class stops the scan state machine of a microscope stage: cap.motion.stop.v1 stops motion, not a running line scan, and it binds motion.axis rather than optics.stage
catalogue_requests.summary: Stop a running line scan (the native stop_scan); it takes no input.

notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level); the gate reported no warnings. Model-authored and unreviewed. Scope: the clone is a light-sheet microscope framework and the card lists five entry symbols; the package implements only the first, navigate.model.devices.stage.asi:MS2000Stage, and the x/y/z axes of its default mapping. NOT COVERED: MFC2000Stage, XCaliburPump, LuxxLaser and SyntheticCamera (other device classes of the same clone); the theta/phi axes and the scan range commands (scanr/scanv) of this stage; and any image or array output. The axis travel range is Limit.operator_required because the clone takes x_min/x_max from the site microscope configuration and no text states a bound; site-limits.example.json is an example overlay, not a statement about any unit. The hardware path (native.py, the Tiger controller connection) was never run, and the fake is an in-memory stand-in, not a recording of a device. RESULT.json is written last; check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.

MODEL REVIEW (claude-opus-5-5, a model and not a human, 2026-10-29; reviewed_by stays null): accepted; the reviewer changed no file of the package. After the registry rebuild refreshed task.json, the reviewer re-ran the gate and wrote its digest above.
